Specification: This module defines a JSON-exporting invariant wrapper around an existing EWD840 specification rather than introducing a new algorithm. It relies on definitions imported from the extended module EWD840, especially the invariant Inv, and uses TLC/community-module operators to serialize the execution trace to a JSON file when the underlying invariant is violated. The design intentionally exploits TLC's evaluation of the disjuncts of JsonInv so that, when the real invariant is false, the Export branch writes Trace to trace.json and sets the TLC exit flag, allowing model checking to stop without the usual textual error trace unless that flag is changed.
